---
title: "Plant growth"
output: html_document
---

A small report on R's built-in `PlantGrowth` data.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
groups <- split(PlantGrowth$weight, PlantGrowth$group)
```

The mean weight per group:

```{r means}
means <- sapply(groups, mean)
means
```

This chunk is shown but never evaluated:

```{r eval = FALSE}
install.packages("ggplot2")
```

```{r plot}
barplot(means, ylab = "weight")
best <- names(which.max(means))
```

The heaviest plants grew in group `r best`.
